cases.question: in which month was the revenue more than average
cases.reply:
Average monthly revenue in Aug 2026 – Sep 2026: **₹40.89 Cr**.
This is the arithmetic mean of complete calendar-month totals, including zero-activity months.
Months strictly above this average:
- **Sep 2026**: ₹42.63 Cr
_Note: Excluded partial edge months so the average compares complete calendar months._

mean.label: Arithmetic mean of complete monthly totals
mean.sql:
WITH monthly AS (SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', date) AS DATE) AS period, SUM(revenue) AS "revenue" FROM sales_daily WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY period ORDER BY period),
      calendar AS (SELECT CAST(month AS DATE) AS period FROM generate_series(CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE), CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE), INTERVAL '1 month') AS t(month)),
      monthly_values AS (SELECT calendar.period, COALESCE(monthly."revenue", 0) AS monthly_value FROM calendar LEFT JOIN monthly USING (period))
      SELECT period, monthly_value, AVG(monthly_value) OVER () AS monthly_average FROM monthly_values ORDER BY period
mean.calculation: SUM(monthly totals) / number of complete calendar months; zero-activity months count as zero; strict comparison.

cases.question: which months had revenue above average in 2011
cases.reply:
Average monthly revenue (gbp) in Jan 2011 – Nov 2011: **GBP 834,806.16**.
This is the arithmetic mean of complete calendar-month totals, including zero-activity months.
Months strictly above this average:
- **Sep 2011**: GBP 1,056,435.19
- **Oct 2011**: GBP 1,151,263.73
- **Nov 2011**: GBP 1,503,866.78
_Note: Data is only available from 01 Dec 2009 to 09 Dec 2011, so I limited the range to 01 Jan 2011 – 09 Dec 2011._
_Note: Excluded partial edge months so the average compares complete calendar months._
_Dataset: UCI Online Retail II / imported historical sales / GBP. External causes are not established by transaction data._

mean.label: Arithmetic mean of complete monthly totals
mean.sql:
WITH monthly AS (SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', date) AS DATE) AS period, SUM(revenue) AS "revenue" FROM uci_sales WHERE date BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-11-30' GROUP BY period ORDER BY period),
      calendar AS (SELECT CAST(month AS DATE) AS period FROM generate_series(CAST('2011-01-01' AS DATE), CAST('2011-11-30' AS DATE), INTERVAL '1 month') AS t(month)),
      monthly_values AS (SELECT calendar.period, COALESCE(monthly."revenue", 0) AS monthly_value FROM calendar LEFT JOIN monthly USING (period))
      SELECT period, monthly_value, AVG(monthly_value) OVER () AS monthly_average FROM monthly_values ORDER BY period
mean.metric_definition: Revenue is gross merchandise sales: SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) in GBP for positive quantity and price, excluding C-prefixed cancellation invoices, returns (negative quantity), invalid dates/numbers, missing invoice/stock code/country, and exact duplicate source rows. Missing customer IDs are retained; missing descriptions use StockCode. No inferred VAT, margin, exchange rate, shipping, or external causal claims.
mean.calculation: SUM(monthly totals) / number of complete calendar months; zero-activity months count as zero; strict comparison.
